ru.translation: Это решает моё единственное замечание. В целом история сфокусирована, а доказательства убедительны.
ru.usageNote: Ends with an honest positive judgement.

examples.text: That resolves my only concern. Overall, though, the story is focused, the evidence is credible, and the presentation is ready once that label changes.

npcReplyCorrect: Thanks. I will change the label and leave the rest of the structure as it is.

displayForm: I think there's been a misunderstanding. What I meant was that seven o'clock doesn't work for me, not that I don't want to come to dinner.

ru.translation: Думаю, произошло недопонимание. Я имел в виду, что мне не подходит семь, а не что я не хочу приходить.
ru.usageNote: Replaces the hurtful interpretation precisely.

examples.text: I think there's been a misunderstanding. What I meant was that seven o'clock doesn't work for me, not that I don't want to come to dinner.

npcReplyCorrect: But you said it would not work and then left. It sounded as if you were dismissing the whole plan.

displayForm: I didn't mean to dismiss it. I had to join a work call, but I should have explained that instead of leaving you to guess.

ru.translation: Я не хотел отвергать план. Мне нужно было подключиться к звонку, но следовало это объяснить.
ru.usageNote: Clarifies intent while acknowledging effect.

examples.text: I didn't mean to dismiss it. I had to join a work call, but I should have explained that instead of leaving you to guess.

npcReplyCorrect: I wish you had messaged afterwards. Maya and I thought you were annoyed with us.

displayForm: You're right. I assumed Maya would pass on my explanation, and that was my part in the mix-up. What I meant was that I can come if we start at eight.

ru.translation: Ты прав. Я предположил, что Майя всё объяснит, и это была моя часть путаницы. Я смогу прийти к восьми.
ru.usageNote: Accepts responsibility and restates intent.

examples.text: You're right. I assumed Maya would pass on my explanation, and that was my part in the mix-up. What I meant was that I can come if we start at eight.

npcReplyCorrect: Thank you for saying that. I thought seven was fixed, but I can ask whether eight is possible.

displayForm: I understand that changing the booking creates work. If eight isn't possible, I'll join you after my call rather than miss the evening. I do want to be there.

ru.translation: Я понимаю, что изменение брони создаёт работу. Если восемь невозможно, я присоединюсь после звонка. Я хочу прийти.
ru.usageNote: Restores trust through concrete flexibility.

examples.text: I understand that changing the booking creates work. If eight isn't possible, I'll join you after my call rather than miss the evening. I do want to be there.

npcReplyCorrect: That clears it up. I will check the booking, and either way we will expect you after the call.

displayForm: I think there's been a scheduling misunderstanding. What I meant in the group chat was Thursday at the café; I didn't realise you were confirming Tuesday.

ru.translation: Думаю, возникло недопонимание по расписанию. Я имел в виду четверг, а не вторник.
ru.usageNote: Transfers repair to scheduling ambiguity.

examples.text: I think there's been a scheduling misunderstanding. What I meant in the group chat was Thursday at the café; I didn't realise you were confirming Tuesday.

npcReplyCorrect: I waited there on Tuesday because your reply came directly after my message about that day.

displayForm: I see why you read it that way, and I should have named the day again. I didn't mean to leave you waiting. Could we meet Thursday, and I'll confirm it separately now?

ru.translation: Я понимаю, почему ты так прочитал. Я не хотел заставлять тебя ждать. Встретимся в четверг, и я сейчас подтвержу отдельно.
ru.usageNote: Owns ambiguity and makes a clear repair.

examples.text: I see why you read it that way, and I should have named the day again. I didn't mean to leave you waiting. Could we meet Thursday, and I'll confirm it separately now?

npcReplyCorrect: Yes, Thursday works. A separate confirmation will prevent the same mix-up.

displayForm: I didn't mean to exclude you from the concert. I had one spare ticket and had already promised it to my sister before we spoke.

ru.translation: Я не хотел исключать тебя из похода на концерт. Запасной билет уже был обещан сестре.
ru.usageNote: Clarifies prior commitment without denying feeling.

examples.text: I didn't mean to exclude you from the concert. I had one spare ticket and had already promised it to my sister before we spoke.

npcReplyCorrect: It still felt personal because you changed the subject when I asked who was going.

displayForm: I understand why that hurt. I changed the subject because I felt awkward, and that made it look worse. What I meant was that the ticket was already committed, not that I didn't want to go with you.

ru.translation: Я понимаю, почему это задело. Я сменил тему из-за неловкости. Билет уже был обещан, но я хотел бы пойти с тобой.
ru.usageNote: Owns avoidance and repairs the meaning.

examples.text: I understand why that hurt. I changed the subject because I felt awkward, and that made it look worse. What I meant was that the ticket was already committed, not that I didn't want to go with you.

npcReplyCorrect: That explanation makes more sense. Next time, please tell me directly.

displayForm: The entrance mix-up was partly my fault. I told Maya that the picnic had moved to the east gate, but I didn't mean to assume she would tell you as well.

ru.translation: Путаница со входом была отчасти моей ошибкой. Я сообщил Майе о восточных воротах, но ошибочно предположил, что она скажет тебе.
ru.usageNote: Makes self-correction central.

examples.text: The entrance mix-up was partly my fault. I told Maya that the picnic had moved to the east gate, but I didn't mean to assume she would tell you as well.

npcReplyCorrect: I was frustrated because everyone else seemed to know, and I thought I had been left out deliberately.

displayForm: I can see why it felt deliberate, even though it wasn't. I should have messaged each person. I'll do that now and come to meet you at the main gate.

ru.translation: Я понимаю, почему это выглядело намеренно. Мне следовало написать каждому. Сейчас я встречу тебя у главных ворот.
ru.usageNote: Acknowledges impact and repairs the immediate situation.

examples.text: I can see why it felt deliberate, even though it wasn't. I should have messaged each person. I'll do that now and come to meet you at the main gate.

npcReplyCorrect: Thank you. Meeting me there fixes today, and messaging everyone directly will prevent it next time.

displayForm: The tablet battery now lasts less than an hour, although I bought it three weeks ago. A repair would leave me without the device I need for work.

ru.translation: Батарея планшета теперь работает меньше часа, хотя я купил его три недели назад. Ремонт оставит меня без устройства для работы.
ru.usageNote: Establishes evidence and impact before negotiating.

examples.text: The tablet battery now lasts less than an hour, although I bought it three weeks ago. A repair would leave me without the device I need for work.

npcReplyCorrect: I can confirm the battery fault. After fourteen days our standard policy is a repair, which normally takes five working days.

displayForm: Let's see if we can find a solution that works for both of us. I'm willing to let a technician verify the fault today, but I cannot manage a week without a device.

ru.translation: Давайте найдём решение, которое подойдёт нам обоим. Я готов сегодня дать технику проверить неисправность, но не могу неделю быть без устройства.
ru.usageNote: Offers cooperation with a clear boundary.

examples.text: Let's see if we can find a solution that works for both of us. I'm willing to let a technician verify the fault today, but I cannot manage a week without a device.

npcReplyCorrect: If the fault is confirmed, I can offer an immediate replacement of the same model instead of sending yours away.

displayForm: The replacement helps with timing, but this model has several recent battery complaints. In that case, I'm willing to accept store credit if it covers the full price and lets me choose a different model.

ru.translation: Замена решает проблему времени, но на эту модель есть жалобы. Я готов принять кредит магазина на полную сумму для другой модели.
ru.usageNote: Evaluates risk and introduces a bounded third option.

examples.text: The replacement helps with timing, but this model has several recent battery complaints. In that case, I'm willing to accept store credit if it covers the full price and lets me choose a different model.

npcReplyCorrect: I can issue full-value credit today. It normally expires in six months, and a different model may cost more.

displayForm: A six-month credit works if I can use it online as well as here. I'll pay any difference for the model I choose; that feels like a solution that works for both of us.

ru.translation: Кредит на шесть месяцев подходит, если им можно воспользоваться онлайн и здесь. Разницу за другую модель я оплачу.
ru.usageNote: Closes with reciprocal responsibilities.

examples.text: A six-month credit works if I can use it online as well as here. I'll pay any difference for the model I choose; that feels like a solution that works for both of us.

npcReplyCorrect: Agreed. The credit will cover the original price, work online and in store, and remain valid for six months.

displayForm: The cleaning service cancelled twice after taking my deposit. I'm willing to accept the documented travel fee, but I'd like the remaining deposit refunded rather than another booking.

ru.translation: Сервис уборки дважды отменил визит после получения депозита. Я готов принять подтверждённую дорожную плату, но остальную сумму хочу вернуть.
ru.usageNote: Transfers the negotiation to a failed service.

examples.text: The cleaning service cancelled twice after taking my deposit. I'm willing to accept the documented travel fee, but I'd like the remaining deposit refunded rather than another booking.

npcReplyCorrect: We can offer priority rebooking next week, but refunds normally deduct both travel visits.

displayForm: No cleaner reached my address on either date, so charging two visits would not work for me. Could we keep one reasonable administration fee and refund the rest as a solution that works for both of us?

ru.translation: Ни в одну дату уборщик не приехал. Можно удержать одну разумную административную плату и вернуть остальное?
ru.usageNote: Counters with a proportionate shared solution.

examples.text: No cleaner reached my address on either date, so charging two visits would not work for me. Could we keep one reasonable administration fee and refund the rest as a solution that works for both of us?

npcReplyCorrect: That is fair. I will retain one small administration fee and refund the rest today.

displayForm: I understand cash refunds take longer. I'm willing to accept store credit instead if it is for the full headphone price and has no short expiry date.

ru.translation: Я понимаю, что денежный возврат дольше. Я готов принять кредит магазина на полную стоимость без короткого срока действия.
ru.usageNote: Evaluates store credit as a genuine third option.

examples.text: I understand cash refunds take longer. I'm willing to accept store credit instead if it is for the full headphone price and has no short expiry date.

npcReplyCorrect: I can provide full credit immediately, valid for twelve months on any audio product.

displayForm: In that case, the twelve-month credit works for me, provided the faulty headphones are collected at no extra cost.

ru.translation: В таком случае кредит на двенадцать месяцев подходит при бесплатном возврате неисправных наушников.
ru.usageNote: Adds a necessary practical condition before agreement.

examples.text: In that case, the twelve-month credit works for me, provided the faulty headphones are collected at no extra cost.

npcReplyCorrect: Agreed. Collection is free, and the credit will activate when the courier scans the return.

displayForm: I've already reported the damaged desk twice: the first replacement had the same crack, and yesterday's collection never arrived. I'm willing to arrange one final collection, but I now need a refund rather than a third desk.

ru.translation: Я уже дважды сообщал о повреждённом столе: замена была с такой же трещиной, а вчера за товаром не приехали. Я готов на последний вывоз, но теперь нужен возврат.
ru.usageNote: Uses two failed attempts as relevant continuity.

examples.text: I've already reported the damaged desk twice: the first replacement had the same crack, and yesterday's collection never arrived. I'm willing to arrange one final collection, but I now need a refund rather than a third desk.

npcReplyCorrect: I see both case notes. I can authorise a refund after collection, but the next courier slot is Friday.

displayForm: Friday is acceptable if you confirm the collection window and refund date today. That avoids another missed visit and gives both sides a clear final step.

ru.translation: Пятница подходит, если сегодня подтвердят окно вывоза и дату возврата. Так у обеих сторон будет ясный финальный шаг.
ru.usageNote: Turns history into safeguards for the final resolution.

examples.text: Friday is acceptable if you confirm the collection window and refund date today. That avoids another missed visit and gives both sides a clear final step.

npcReplyCorrect: I will confirm the two-hour window now, and the refund will be released within one day of collection.

displayForm: I hear you, but I have to insist that the bill reflect the six guests confirmed in writing. We should not be charged for two meals that were neither ordered nor served.

ru.translation: Я вас слышу, но должен настаивать, чтобы счёт отражал шесть гостей, подтверждённых письменно. Мы не должны платить за два незаказанных блюда.
ru.usageNote: Acknowledges Leo before stating the essential position and evidence.

examples.text: I hear you, but I have to insist that the bill reflect the six guests confirmed in writing. We should not be charged for two meals that were neither ordered nor served.

npcReplyCorrect: The kitchen prepared ingredients for eight because the original booking was for eight. Reducing the number created a cost we could not recover.

displayForm: With respect, your confirmation says the final number could change until noon, and we changed it at ten. I still believe the restaurant should follow that written condition.

ru.translation: При всём уважении, в подтверждении сказано, что число можно изменить до полудня, и мы изменили его в десять. Ресторан должен соблюдать это условие.
ru.usageNote: Answers the counterargument without personal attack.

examples.text: With respect, your confirmation says the final number could change until noon, and we changed it at ten. I still believe the restaurant should follow that written condition.

npcReplyCorrect: I accept that the message was on time. However, the supplier order had already been placed, so I cannot remove every related cost.

displayForm: I'm willing to discuss a small ingredient cost if you show it separately, but I have to insist that the two full set-menu charges are removed.

ru.translation: Я готов обсудить небольшую стоимость ингредиентов, если она указана отдельно, но настаиваю на снятии двух полных меню.
ru.usageNote: Offers a bounded concession while protecting the main point.

examples.text: I'm willing to discuss a small ingredient cost if you show it separately, but I have to insist that the two full set-menu charges are removed.

npcReplyCorrect: I can remove the two meals and add a ten-pound preparation charge with an explanation on the bill.

displayForm: That is a reasonable distinction. Please remove the two meals and show the ten-pound preparation charge clearly; then we can settle the bill now.

ru.translation: Это разумное различие. Уберите два блюда и отдельно укажите десять фунтов за подготовку; тогда мы оплатим счёт.
ru.usageNote: Accepts a transparent resolution without abandoning the core position.

examples.text: That is a reasonable distinction. Please remove the two meals and show the ten-pound preparation charge clearly; then we can settle the bill now.

npcReplyCorrect: Agreed. I will bring the corrected bill and attach the written explanation.

displayForm: I hear that outside cakes create extra work, but I have to insist that the undisclosed thirty-pound fee is removed. Your booking email says outside cakes are allowed and mentions no charge.

ru.translation: Я понимаю, что принесённый торт создаёт работу, но настаиваю на снятии неуказанной платы в тридцать фунтов. В письме разрешён торт без упоминания сбора.
ru.usageNote: Transfers firmness to a new restaurant fee with Leo retained.

examples.text: I hear that outside cakes create extra work, but I have to insist that the undisclosed thirty-pound fee is removed. Your booking email says outside cakes are allowed and mentions no charge.

npcReplyCorrect: We still provide plates, storage and cleanup. Those services have a real cost even if the email omitted the fee.

displayForm: With respect, I would have decided differently if the fee had been disclosed. I'm willing to pay ten pounds for the actual cleanup, but not a charge introduced after the meal.

ru.translation: При всём уважении, при известной плате я решил бы иначе. Я готов заплатить десять фунтов за уборку, но не сбор, введённый после ужина.
ru.usageNote: Uses the new constraint to define a proportionate concession.

examples.text: With respect, I would have decided differently if the fee had been disclosed. I'm willing to pay ten pounds for the actual cleanup, but not a charge introduced after the meal.

npcReplyCorrect: I can accept ten pounds for the service used and remove the undisclosed balance.

displayForm: I accept that our final guest count arrived thirty minutes late, and a small administration charge is reasonable. However, I have to insist that two complete unused meals are not charged.

ru.translation: Я признаю, что итоговое число гостей пришло на тридцать минут позже, и небольшая административная плата разумна. Но настаиваю, чтобы два неиспользованных меню не оплачивались.
ru.usageNote: Concedes the minor procedural point while holding the main one.

examples.text: I accept that our final guest count arrived thirty minutes late, and a small administration charge is reasonable. However, I have to insist that two complete unused meals are not charged.

npcReplyCorrect: The late notice did create work, but I agree it is different from serving two meals.

displayForm: Then let's separate those issues: I'm willing to pay the administration charge, provided the two meal charges are removed and the reason is shown clearly.

ru.translation: Тогда разделим вопросы: я готов оплатить административный сбор при снятии двух блюд и ясном объяснении.
ru.usageNote: Converts nuance into transparent settlement terms.

examples.text: Then let's separate those issues: I'm willing to pay the administration charge, provided the two meal charges are removed and the reason is shown clearly.

npcReplyCorrect: That is acceptable. I will itemise the administration charge and remove both meals.

displayForm: I hear your view that the forty-minute delay was acceptable on a busy night. With respect, I still believe it fell below the service we were promised.

ru.translation: Я слышу вашу позицию, что сорок минут ожидания допустимы в загруженный вечер. При всём уважении, я по-прежнему считаю, что сервис был хуже обещанного.
ru.usageNote: Maintains a respectful evaluative disagreement.

examples.text: I hear your view that the forty-minute delay was acceptable on a busy night. With respect, I still believe it fell below the service we were promised.

npcReplyCorrect: We may not agree about the delay, and I cannot change the menu prices after the food was served.

displayForm: Let's agree to disagree about the standard of service. I have to insist only that the optional service charge is removed; I'll pay the full food and drink total now.

ru.translation: Давайте останемся при своих взглядах на качество сервиса. Я настаиваю лишь на снятии добровольного сервисного сбора и оплачу еду и напитки.
ru.usageNote: Ends without forced agreement while resolving the actionable point.

examples.text: Let's agree to disagree about the standard of service. I have to insist only that the optional service charge is removed; I'll pay the full food and drink total now.

npcReplyCorrect: We can do that. I will remove the optional charge, and we will leave our different views on the delay on record.

displayForm: I found The Last Station quite visually impressive, but the middle felt rushed because the film compressed several important choices into one scene.

ru.translation: «Последняя станция» показалась мне визуально впечатляющей, но середина была скомкана из-за объединения важных решений в одну сцену.
ru.usageNote: Gives a qualified evaluation with evidence.

examples.text: I found The Last Station quite visually impressive, but the middle felt rushed because the film compressed several important choices into one scene.

npcReplyCorrect: I liked the faster middle. The book spends much longer on the sister's doubts, and I thought the film gained energy by cutting them.

displayForm: Compared with the book, the film is more energetic, but the sister's final decision feels less convincing because we see fewer of her doubts.

ru.translation: По сравнению с книгой фильм динамичнее, но решение сестры менее убедительно, потому что мы видим меньше сомнений.
ru.usageNote: Compares effect rather than listing plot differences.

examples.text: Compared with the book, the film is more energetic, but the sister's final decision feels less convincing because we see fewer of her doubts.

npcReplyCorrect: That is fair. I cared more about the central journey, so I did not miss all of her internal conflict. What did you make of the ending?

displayForm: I found the ending quite powerful as an image. However, compared with the novel's ambiguity, it explains the message too neatly and gives the audience less to interpret.

ru.translation: Финал показался мне сильным визуально. Однако по сравнению с неоднозначностью романа он слишком аккуратно объясняет посыл.
ru.usageNote: Evaluates a creative trade-off and responds to Alex.

examples.text: I found the ending quite powerful as an image. However, compared with the novel's ambiguity, it explains the message too neatly and gives the audience less to interpret.

npcReplyCorrect: I preferred that clarity, although I can see why the open ending suits the book. Would you still recommend the film?

displayForm: Yes, especially to someone who has not read the novel. I'd describe it as a strong adaptation rather than a complete one: it captures the atmosphere, but not every viewpoint.

ru.translation: Да, особенно тому, кто не читал роман. Это сильная, но не полная адаптация: она передаёт атмосферу, но не все точки зрения.
ru.usageNote: Ends with a qualified recommendation.

examples.text: Yes, especially to someone who has not read the novel. I'd describe it as a strong adaptation rather than a complete one: it captures the atmosphere, but not every viewpoint.

npcReplyCorrect: That distinction makes sense. I would recommend the film for its momentum and the book for its fuller character perspective.

displayForm: I found the first season quite uneven, but the slower episodes gave the supporting characters room to change rather than simply moving the mystery forward.

ru.translation: Первый сезон показался мне неровным, но медленные серии дали второстепенным героям возможность измениться.
ru.usageNote: Transfers evaluation to serial storytelling.

examples.text: I found the first season quite uneven, but the slower episodes gave the supporting characters room to change rather than simply moving the mystery forward.

npcReplyCorrect: I thought those episodes interrupted the suspense. Did the character development justify the slower pace for you?

displayForm: Mostly, yes. Compared with a two-hour film, the series can show why loyalties change, although two episodes repeated the same conflict.

ru.translation: В основном да. По сравнению с двухчасовым фильмом сериал показывает причины изменений, хотя две серии повторяют конфликт.
ru.usageNote: Weighs the medium's advantage against repetition.

examples.text: Mostly, yes. Compared with a two-hour film, the series can show why loyalties change, although two episodes repeated the same conflict.

npcReplyCorrect: That is a balanced criticism. The extra time deepened the characters, but the structure could have been tighter.

displayForm: I know you found the ending satisfying, but I found it quite forced. The sudden confession solves a conflict that the film had treated as morally complicated.

ru.translation: Я знаю, что финал тебя удовлетворил, но мне он показался натянутым. Внезапное признание решает морально сложный конфликт.
ru.usageNote: Maintains an opposite opinion with a reason.

examples.text: I know you found the ending satisfying, but I found it quite forced. The sudden confession solves a conflict that the film had treated as morally complicated.

npcReplyCorrect: For me, the confession completed the character's arc. Without it, the ending might have felt unfinished.

displayForm: I see that structure, but I still prefer the unresolved version. Compared with a neat confession, uncertainty would have matched the character's earlier choices more honestly.

ru.translation: Я понимаю структуру, но предпочитаю нерешённый вариант. По сравнению с аккуратным признанием неопределённость честнее соответствовала прежним решениям героя.
ru.usageNote: Responds directly without collapsing disagreement.

examples.text: I see that structure, but I still prefer the unresolved version. Compared with a neat confession, uncertainty would have matched the character's earlier choices more honestly.

npcReplyCorrect: We value different kinds of resolution, then. Your reading is consistent even though I prefer the clearer ending.

displayForm: Compared with the director's earlier film, this one is less visually playful but more emotionally controlled. I found the quieter style quite effective for the family story.

ru.translation: По сравнению с ранним фильмом режиссёра этот менее визуально игривый, но эмоционально сдержаннее. Тихий стиль подходит семейной истории.
ru.usageNote: Adds creator-level comparison as evidence.

examples.text: Compared with the director's earlier film, this one is less visually playful but more emotionally controlled. I found the quieter style quite effective for the family story.

npcReplyCorrect: The earlier film took more risks with colour and editing. Do you think this restraint shows growth or caution?

displayForm: A bit of both. The restraint shows greater confidence with actors, but compared with the earlier work, some scenes feel less distinctive. I would call it a deeper film, not necessarily a more original one.

ru.translation: И то и другое. Сдержанность показывает уверенность в работе с актёрами, но сцены менее самобытны. Фильм глубже, но не обязательно оригинальнее.
ru.usageNote: Makes a nuanced comparative judgement.

examples.text: A bit of both. The restraint shows greater confidence with actors, but compared with the earlier work, some scenes feel less distinctive. I would call it a deeper film, not necessarily a more original one.

npcReplyCorrect: That is a useful distinction: stronger emotional direction, but fewer memorable formal choices.
